answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and posts a public thread of milestones, checked against a nebula of prior work. Auditors replay the nebula: a milestone copied from elsewhere, or a thread with no real work, burns the bond. A missed milestone sends a ripple down the thread, flagging later milestones. First 40, thousandth 6,034: a rented-milestone ring of 1,000 pays 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. Honest agents pay 40 once.
